name.title: Name
name.description: The job's name, as shown on the import results screen.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: What the job does: Import, Update (a bulk update) or Delete (a bulk delete).

status.title: Status
status.description: One of: Draft, Parsing, Dry run, Dry run complete, Committing, Complete, Failed, Undoing, Undone, Undo failed. Dry run and Committing mean it is still running.

isDryRun.title: Is Dry Run
isDryRun.description: True when the job only checked the rows and saved nothing.

fileName.title: File Name
fileName.description: The name of the file imported, if any.

rowCount.title: Row Count
rowCount.description: How many rows the job has.

rowsCreated.title: Rows Created
rowsCreated.description: How many rows created a record.

rowsUpdated.title: Rows Updated
rowsUpdated.description: How many rows updated a record.

rowsMatched.title: Rows Matched
rowsMatched.description: How many rows matched an existing record and changed nothing.

rowsRejected.title: Rows Rejected
rowsRejected.description: How many rows were refused. The reasons are on the import results screen.

completedAt.title: Completed At
completedAt.description: When the job finished. Empty while it is running.

undoDeadline.title: Undo Deadline
undoDeadline.description: Until when the job can still be undone on the import results screen. Empty when it cannot be undone.

errorMessage.title: Error Message
errorMessage.description: Empty when the job was found. Otherwise why not, in plain words to show the user.
